full_page.content:
1952, March 18th
The following is the faithful transcription of the typewritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap.
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 HUNTINGTON, INDIANA
Miss Margaret Haf, 36253 Michigan Ave. Wayne, Michigan
God bless you dear Miss Haf. - you and yours.
You must think that there must be something not exactly right with that old Fr. Solanus down at Saint Felix. Indeed there is plenty wrong with him - has always been, at least as long as I can remember. Deo gratias. I wrote Rev. Mother yesterday and gave her every every assurance of my approval of your joining them - in fact congratulating them on your aquisition and enrolling their community in the Seraphic Mass Association in the hopes that you may in one or more ways presage a speeding up of vocations -- Ahl God willing, a speeding up in numbers and holyness before God.
God bless you again Miss Haf - as above. It is time for the collecter. So please pardon my abruptness.
Remind me again of the Clairs, and about your poor Brother too. God help us.
Sincerely yours in Christ Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Original in possession of:
Miss Margaret E. Haf
24 18 Coolidge #203
Troy, MI. 48084
